system.description:
Kishai Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Legendary[1], Salt. No item slots.

Prerequisites: Transport: Sailing[1]

An enormous stone ship, carved in the neolithic era, with rough-hewn designs of suns and grasslands. The Skif is well-worn, but she functions still.

Skif (Passive): The Skif is treated as a Sailboat (in both Sacadia’s Art of War and Myths of Sacadia rules), with one exception:

Heartstone Engine (Passive): The Skif does not sail on water. Instead, it sails across the surface of grass, its base just touching the surface of whatever grasslands you cross.

Engine Failure (Reaction): If the Skif reaches 0HP at any point, it explodes in a vibrant blast. Creatures in the blast radius take damage according how far away they are from the center of the ship (outlined below). Creatures may choose to make a Finesse Check (negating damage) or a Power Check (halving damage). Any creature who takes damage from this effect is knocked Prone.
0-10ft:16D10 Fire Damage (DC26 Finesse, DC20 Power)
11-20ft: 12D10 Fire Damage (DC23 Finesse, DC18 Power)
21-30ft: 8D10 Fire Damage (DC20 Finesse, DC16 Power)
31-40ft: 4D10 Fire Damage (DC17 Finesse, DC4 Power)

Rulebook p.78.
